lineage: W-R21 branch PR#53 original first-use run 38358152995 invalid due unbound offset name; preserve original branch and no replay. W-R22 is a new frozen source and new cohort, based on last qualified W-R20 head rather than invalid branch.
question: Can exactly four observed transition labels identify an unknown member of eight predeclared small causal recurrence hypotheses with unseen-context transfer?
frozen_family: Second-order x[t]=(x[t-1]+a*x[t-2]+b)%4, a in [1,2], b in [0,1,2,3], precisely eight candidates. True source seed S 80..83 uses a=2 for even S else1 and b=(S-80)%4; model only receives four training labels, NOT seed or true parameters.

split.calibration_labels: t2 first transition for episodes e0,e1,e2,e3 per heldout seed
split.test: episodes e4..e15, each predicted t2..t31, 360 new-context test labels per seed

generator: Each episode starts x0=(e+seed)%4 and x1=(e//4+3*seed)%4, 32 ticks, no noise. During e0..3, x1 constant and x0 spans four possible values; candidate feasibility identifiable.
arms: 16x4 count memorizer trained only on four labels, unknown contexts deterministic tie label0
selected one of eight fixed (a,b) by zero prediction errors over four labels; ambiguous set invalid and archived
same selected hypothesis evaluated on history prefix reordered even positions then odd positions, no future symbol access
fixed_preflight: Before original first-use, ONLY use four independent manually authored sentinel tuples [(0,0,1),(1,0,2),(2,0,3),(3,0,0)] to assert selector returns uniquely (a1,b1). This checks source binding and semantics, NOT any real research cohort results.
criterion: BOUNDED_HYPOTHESIS_TRANSFER iff selected accuracy>=.95 and all three controls<=.65 on four heldout seeds; PARTIAL if selected > all controls but criterion unmet; NEGATIVE otherwise; ambiguity/failure recorded.
limits: Predetermined eight-template syntax and synthetic supervised observations, no broad autonomous discovery or natural-language learning.
safeguards: Prereg frozen before source, separate branch/source/artifact, no retrospective R21 replay, first-use only one run, exact parent/prereg/source blob checks and final full regression.
